summary: Build practical citizen engagement skills, apply the IAP2 Spectrum, and create accountable participation plans. Enrol in the five-day course.
lede: Training in citizen engagement and participatory governance helps policy and engagement professionals design accountable participation in public decisions. Practitioners learn to map stakeholders and improve inclusion, design deliberative sessions, and analyse qualitative feedback so input can be traced into decision-making. They also practise accessibility checks, participation risk controls, and reporting outcomes across digital, face-to-face, and hybrid methods.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who plan, deliver, govern, evaluate, or report citizen engagement and participatory governance activities. It suits intermediate practitioners with experience in public programmes, community-facing work, policy development, service delivery, or organizational governance.
prerequisites: You should have practical experience in public consultation, community engagement, policy work, service delivery, programme management, or governance reporting. No coding is required. Basic familiarity with stakeholder analysis and document-based reporting is helpful. Advanced digital participation concepts are taught at operational application level, while production software configuration and statistical modelling are outside the course scope.
